from pytesseract import pytesseract

def count_poles(image, threshold=0.3, model_size="tiny"):
    result = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, threshold=threshold, model=model_size)
    if "left" in result:
        result = result.split(" ")[-1]
    elif "right" in result:
        result = result.split(" ")[-2]
    return int(result)

# Load detected images
images_with_labels = ["/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_85_image_1.jpg"]
predictions = [count_poles(image) for image in images_with_labels]

final_result = max(predictions, key=predictions.__len__)

if final_result is None:
    print("No poles detected.")
else:
    print(f"Number of poles: {final_result}")
</command>
